core_models.name: 第一性原理量化验证
core_models.rule: 任何主张若不可测量则不成立；以物理约束（电压、成本、瓦特）而非共识作判据
evidence: And if somebody says it does make a difference, I'm like, how will you measure it? And if you can't even measure it, then it's bullshit.

core_models.name: 成本×规模杠杆思维
